coreFinding: PF066 orders ETF PCF revisions by last capture timestamp. Later recapture of older issuer version can roll back an earlier observed newer raw version. CapturedAt measures observer time, not authoritative issuer revision precedence.

counterexamples.scenario: 08:00 raw v1; 08:10 raw v2; 08:20 stale cached raw v1; decision 08:30
counterexamples.required: UNKNOWN unless issuer-version order independently authenticated; never silently roll back to v1

counterexamples.scenario: 08:00 raw v1; 08:10 raw v2; 08:20 stale index v1; decision 08:30
counterexamples.required: UNKNOWN unless issuer-version order independently authenticated

counterexamples.scenario: Only one revision identity observed as-of; raw bytes checksum matches
counterexamples.required: STRUCTURAL_PASS_NOT_PIT_CERTIFIED until immutable issuer original and independent capture clock are externally attested

counterexamples.scenario: A conflicting revision first observed after decision cutoff
counterexamples.required: Ignore future observations for historical decision, but do not fabricate first-known or source-published clock

hypotheses.claim: Later capture means newer issuer revision
hypotheses.support: Freshly fetched pages may reflect corrections
hypotheses.falsification: Cached older v1 can be observed after valid v2
hypotheses.alternative: CDN cache, source mirror lag, delayed index
hypotheses.failure: No issuer-verified monotonic revision lineage; observation time alone cannot order versions

hypotheses.claim: Matching raw-byte hash proves genuine issuer original and PIT
hypotheses.support: Hash catches changes to supplied bytes
hypotheses.falsification: Self-supplied synthetic bytes and fake immutable URI can pass hash
hypotheses.alternative: Trusted independent archive may exist outside selector
hypotheses.failure: No external source receipt and authenticated clock

hypotheses.claim: ETF units increase implies same-day constituent net buying
hypotheses.falsification: Inventory, borrow, cash substitution, gross offset and AP timing yield positive/zero/negative market execution
hypotheses.alternative: Inventory transfer, settlement and index rebalance

hypotheses.claim: Institutional flow, ETF creation, margin, SBL and crowding each independently confirm one direction
hypotheses.support: They may react to common market demand
hypotheses.falsification: Same primitive/information root or index event can generate multiple observations; short borrow can be delivery/hedge
hypotheses.failure: No primitive-level independent lineage and date-clustered residual OOS test

hypotheses.claim: Ownership concentration rise identifies direct purchases
hypotheses.falsification: Threshold crossing, denominator changes and custody accounts can change distribution without equivalent buying
hypotheses.failure: No pair-effective identity and sourceDate-specific common equity universe

implementation: Synthetic research-only guard refuses to choose among multiple as-of revision identities without independent issuer ordering; a single verified-bytes identity receives STRUCTURAL_PASS_NOT_PIT_CERTIFIED, not actual PIT admission.
